[[Cho Wei the Skull Axe]] is a [[Crimson Skull]] [[boss]] that appears in [[Panjiang Peninsula]] at [[Port Kaimu]].

== Locations ==
* [[Shing Jea Island]]
** {{NPC location|Panjiang Peninsula}} (except during [[Togo's Ultimatum]], [[The Siege at Tsumei Village]] and [[Quimang's Last Stand]])

== Skills ==
* {{skill icon|"For Great Justice!"}}
* {{skill icon|Furious Axe}}
* {{skill icon|Penetrating Chop}} 

== Items dropped ==
* [[Bolt of Cloth]]
* [[Bolt of Linen]]
* [[Cho Wei's Axe]] ([[unique]])
* [[Crimson Skull Raiment]]
* [[Silver Crimson Skull Coin]]

== Notes ==
* After defeating [[Captain Quimang]] in [[Quimang's Last Stand]], you may experience difficulty finding Cho Wei at the [[spawn]] point.
== Trivia ==
* Upon approaching Cho Wei's location, a [[Crimson Skull Ritualist]] will appear and walk from the west, /kneel in front of Cho Wei, while the Crimson Skull boss will turn towards the Ritualist and /cheer. The ritualist will then glow with a golden aura, stand up and /cheer, mimicking the interaction between a player character claiming a quest reward, with Cho Wei as the quest giver.
